notes.title: Demo Version 1.2
notes.notes:
It was brought to our attention yesterday that using Ctrl+Shift, and pressing W then jumping would cause you to propel forwards. After a few attempts, you could fly, and fling yourself off the map. After some coding changes in Crouching, you are unable to do this anymore. The movement now only reads the latest input, so Ctrl, then Shift would make you run. Shift, then Ctrl would make you shift.



  Update Size - 71.4KB / BuildID 18827892

Weiner Town:

Re-coded the Crouching element. No longer able to fling yourself off the map
